Rules

Rules

2. The label shows the destination postcode.

Rules
1. A single parcel may weigh at most 30 kg.
2. A parcel over the weight limit is refused at pickup.

## Delivery attempts

Rules
1. A courier makes at most two delivery attempts per parcel.
2. After the second failed attempt the parcel is taken to the local depot.

Rules
1. If a parcel is delivered later than the promised date, the sender is refunded the shipping fee.
2. The refund is paid to the payment method used for the booking.

## Damaged parcel compensation

Rules
1. A sender whose parcel arrives damaged is refunded the declared value of the contents.
2. The damage must be reported within 48 hours of delivery.

## Daily bank settlement

Rules
1. Approved compensation payments are sent to the bank in a settlement run at 17:00 on each working day.
2. A payment approved after 17:00 is sent in the next working day's settlement run.

EV-LV3-H-T9.content:
## Ownership — cancelling a job

Producers and operators can cancel jobs. Cancellation tells Orion to stop investing in the job; it does not reach into a worker and abort work already under way. Because producers retry their own requests, Orion may receive the same cancellation more than once; a repeated cancellation is simply acknowledged.

Normative rule
1. After a job is cancelled, no future execution attempt of that job may be started.
2. Cancellation must not interrupt an execution attempt that is already running; that attempt runs to its own completion, failure or timeout.
3. If Orion receives a cancellation for a job that is already cancelled, the job must remain cancelled and the repeated cancellation must not otherwise change the job's state.

Example
Q-40 is cancelled while its second execution is running; that execution finishes on its own terms and no further execution follows. A second cancellation for Q-40 arrives a minute later; Q-40 stays cancelled and nothing else about Q-40 changes.

EV-LV3-CAPTURE-T1.content:
## Card payment capture

A card payment is captured when the order is dispatched, not when it is placed.

EV-LV3-CARD-CHECK-T1.content:
## Saving a payment card

A new payment card is checked with a zero-amount authorisation before it is saved.

EV-LV3-CHARGEBACK-T1.content:
## Chargeback responses

A chargeback must be answered within 7 days of the card network's notice.

EV-LV3-CONVERSION-T1.content:
## Currency conversion

A payment made in a foreign currency is converted at that day's reference exchange rate.

EV-LV3-CUSTOMER-REFUND-T1.content:
## Refunds for returned orders

A customer who returns an order is refunded the price paid for the returned items.

EV-LV3-FRAUD-HOLD-T1.content:
## Fraud review holds

An order flagged by fraud screening is held until an analyst has reviewed it.

EV-LV3-GIFT-CARD-T1.content:
## Gift cards

A gift card can pay for any order. A gift card balance never expires.

EV-LV3-INSTALMENTS-T1.content:
## Instalment plans

An order may be paid in three monthly instalments.

EV-LV3-INVOICE-T1.content:
## Business invoices

Every order placed by a business customer receives a VAT invoice.

EV-LV3-PAYOUT-T1.content:
## Seller payouts

Sellers are paid out every Friday. A payout is made only when the seller's balance is at least 20 GBP.

EV-LV3-PRICE-VAT-T1.content:
## Displayed prices

Prices shown to consumers include VAT.

EV-LV3-PROMO-T1.content:
## Promotional codes

Only one promotional code can be applied to an order.

EV-LV3-RETRY-T1.content:
## Failed subscription payments

A failed subscription payment is tried again 3 days later. It is tried again at most three times.

EV-LV3-SELLER-LIMIT-T1.content:
## New seller payment limit

A new seller account may receive at most 1,000 GBP in payments during its first 30 days.

EV-LV3-STORE-CREDIT-T1.content:
## Store credit

Store credit expires 12 months after it is issued.

EV-LV3-SUPPLIER-OVERPAYMENT-T1.content:
## Supplier overpayments

A supplier that has been paid more than its invoice total must pay the excess back.

evidence.content:
## Refunds for returned orders

A customer who returns an order is refunded the price paid for the returned items.

## Supplier overpayments

A supplier that has been paid more than its invoice total must pay the excess back.

## Chargeback responses

A chargeback must be answered within 7 days of the card network's notice.

## Seller payouts

Sellers are paid out every Friday. A payout is made only when the seller's balance is at least 20 GBP.

## Currency conversion

A payment made in a foreign currency is converted at that day's reference exchange rate.

## Store credit

Store credit expires 12 months after it is issued.

## Gift cards

A gift card can pay for any order. A gift card balance never expires.

## Business invoices

Every order placed by a business customer receives a VAT invoice.

## Failed subscription payments

A failed subscription payment is tried again 3 days later. It is tried again at most three times.

## Saving a payment card

A new payment card is checked with a zero-amount authorisation before it is saved.

## Fraud review holds

An order flagged by fraud screening is held until an analyst has reviewed it.

## Card payment capture

A card payment is captured when the order is dispatched, not when it is placed.

## New seller payment limit

A new seller account may receive at most 1,000 GBP in payments during its first 30 days.

## Displayed prices

Prices shown to consumers include VAT.

## Instalment plans

An order may be paid in three monthly instalments.

## Promotional codes

Only one promotional code can be applied to an order.
